home.heroTitleLead: Say yes to the wedding that actually
home.heroSubtitle: The Wedding Lab lays your guest list, venues, travel and true cost side by side — so you and your partner choose with your eyes open, before the deposit's gone, not after.
home.heroNote: Free to start · built for two decision-makers, not one
home.howSubheading: Four steps, in order — each one makes the next one easier, not harder.
home.howStep1Body: Group guests by household and travel origin. The Wedding Lab clusters where everyone's coming from automatically, so "how hard is this to get to" stops being a guess.
home.howStep2Body: Save a venue from a link and keep every enquiry, quote and reply in one thread — nothing lives in a scattered inbox only one of you can see.
home.howStep3Title: See the true cost, with a range
home.howStep3Body: Turn a venue, guest count and event plan into a line-by-line budget. Every figure is marked by how confident you actually are in it — guess, researched, confirmed or contracted.
home.howStep4Body: Put your real options side by side: cost range, guest travel difficulty, a live break-even chart. Rate them privately, reveal together, and record the decision you both actually made.
home.featuresHeading: Everything the decision needs — nothing the planning doesn't
home.featuresSubheading: The Wedding Lab stops at the decision on purpose. No seating charts, no vendor timelines — just the choice that everything else depends on.
home.feature1Body: Every guest lives inside a household with a genuine point of origin, so distance and cost roll up correctly instead of being guessed one person at a time.
home.feature2Body: Facts, contacts, documents and the full enquiry thread live with the venue — pull in a listing by its link and The Wedding Lab starts the file for you.
home.feature3Title: A cost engine built on rules, not memory
home.feature3Body: Costs are computed from stored pricing rules, never typed in by hand — change a rule once and every option using it updates with it.
home.feature4Body: See who has to fly, who's driving four hours, and who it's easy for — before you pick the date that turns out to be hardest for the people you love.
home.feature5Title: Side-by-side compare with a break-even chart
home.feature5Body: Line up your shortlisted options against each other across a real guest-count sweep, not a spreadsheet you have to keep rebuilding by hand.
home.feature6Body: Rate options privately, reveal together, and record who decided what and why — so the reasoning is still there six months later, not just the outcome.
home.closingHeading: Decide once. Plan with confidence after.
home.closingBody: The Wedding Lab is for the decision before the planning — the guest list, the venue, the date, the number. Get that right, and everything that comes after gets easier.
home.footerTagline: Built for the decision before the planning.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This page explains how The Wedding Lab handles guest data — the people you're inviting, not just the account holders.
privacy.whatBody: Names, home city and country, whether a guest is a child, and an RSVP status if you record one, for anyone you add as a guest or household member — collected so the app can show travel distance, group sizes and venue costs across your guest list.
privacy.whyHeading: Why this is allowed without asking each guest
privacy.whyBody: Guests don't create accounts or consent individually. We rely on legitimate interest: you're planning a wedding, this data is necessary for that, and it's used only inside your project — never sold, shared with venues automatically, or used for anything else.
privacy.deletionBody: Deleting a guest, a household, or the whole project permanently removes the corresponding data — deleting a project removes every guest record in it, with nothing retained afterward.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about data handled in your project, contact the couple who created it — they control what's stored and can delete it at any time.
